URGENT: Verify Your Financial Aid Information
Dear Student,
Your financial aid account requires immediate verification. Your Fall disbursement has been placed on hold. Click below to prevent your account from being suspended.
Verify Your Account: http://aamu-support.com/finaid/verify-login
Thank you,
AAMU Financial Aid Office

Financial Aid Delayed
Dear Student, we were unable to process your refund of $2,450 because your banking information is incomplete. Reply within 24 hours with your bank account and routing number or your aid will be cancelled. Financial Aid Department

Password Expiration Notice
Dear User,
Your AAMU email password will expire today. To keep your current password, log in at http://aamu.edu.mail-secure.xyz/owa/login and confirm your credentials. Failure to do so will result in your mailbox being deactivated.
IT Help Desk

MAILBOX QUOTA EXCEEDED!!!
Your mailbox has exceeded its storage limit. You will not be able to send or receive new messages until you re-validate your mailbox. CLICK HERE TO UPGRADE: http://185.244.25.11/upgrade/aamu
System Administrator

Exciting Part-Time Administrative Assistant Opportunity!
Dear Students and Staff,
We have a great opportunity for students who are interested in becoming a Personal Assistant (Remote). There will be only 11 hours needed to do this part-time job each week. Flexible hours.
Pay: $550 weekly.
CLICK HERE TO APPLY or send a copy of your resume to my alternative email bruce.d.office@gmail.com.
Best Regards,
Student Coordinator, Alabama A&M University

Research Assistant Position Available
Hello, I am a professor seeking a remote research assistant. No experience needed. You will be paid $400 per week. I will send you a check to purchase supplies and gift cards for the lab. Kindly text me on WhatsApp with your full name and phone number.

Congratulations! You have been selected as a winner of the 2026 Presidential Excellence Scholarship worth $5,000. To claim your award, confirm your student ID, date of birth and social security number at http://aamu-scholarships.online/claim within 48 hours.

Final Notice: Tuition Balance Past Due
Dear Student, your account shows an unpaid balance. You will be dropped from all classes today unless payment is made. Pay now via http://bit.ly/aamu-tuition-pay using a debit card. Office of the Bursar

Unusual sign-in activity on your Canvas account
We detected a suspicious login to your Canvas account. Your access to courses will be restricted. Verify your identity now: https://canvas.instructure.com.secure-verify.ru/login
Canvas Security Team

Action Required: Update Direct Deposit
Dear Employee, due to a payroll system upgrade all staff must update their direct deposit details before Friday or your next paycheck will be withheld. Sign in with your AAMU username and password at http://aamu-hr-portal.com/payroll/update

Your Office 365 account will be suspended
We could not verify your account. Open the attached document and enter your login details to keep access to email and OneDrive. Microsoft Account Team

FAFSA Verification Required
Dear Student, your FAFSA has been flagged for verification. Your grant of $3,200 is on hold. Upload a photo of your driver's license and provide your SSN at http://studentaid-gov.info/verify to release your funds immediately.

You have a package waiting at the campus mail center. Delivery failed due to an incomplete address. Pay the $1.99 redelivery fee within 24 hours: http://aamu-delivery.club/track?id=88231 or the package will be returned.

Dear Staff, as part of our security upgrade, all faculty and staff must reply to this email with their username, password and MFA verification code so we can migrate your account. This is confidential. IT Services Department

Dear Beneficiary, you are eligible for a $1,500 student relief grant. This offer expires today. Click the link below and enter your credit card details to cover the small processing fee: http://education-relief-fund.org.claim-now.xyz/apply

Spring 2027 Registration Opens November 3
Hi Toluwani,
Registration for Spring 2027 opens on November 3 for seniors. Please meet with your academic advisor beforehand to have your advising hold removed. You can view your registration time ticket in Banner Self-Service. Office of the Registrar

CS 405 - Project milestone moved
Hello class,
The project milestone 2 deadline has been moved to Friday, October 9 to give everyone time after the career fair. Please upload your design document to Canvas under Assignments. Office hours are Tuesday 2-4pm in Engineering Building room 210.
Dr. Johnson

Scheduled Maintenance: Saturday Night
Campus Wi-Fi and Banner will be unavailable Saturday from 11pm to 3am for scheduled maintenance. No action is needed on your part. ITS will never ask for your password by email. If you have questions, visit the help desk in the library.

Fall Career Fair - October 14
Join us at the Fall Career and Internship Fair on October 14 from 10am to 2pm in the Student Union ballroom. Over 60 employers will attend, including several engineering and tech companies. Bring copies of your resume and dress professionally. Register on Handshake.

Reminder: 2027-28 FAFSA opens October 1
The 2027-28 FAFSA becomes available on October 1. We encourage all students to complete it early at studentaid.gov. If you need help, our office is open Monday through Friday 8am to 5pm in the Patton Hall. We will never ask for your password.

Your borrowed items are due next week
This is a courtesy reminder that the following items are due on October 12: Introduction to Algorithms (3rd ed.). You can renew items online through your library account or at the circulation desk. Thank you for using the library.

ACM meeting this Thursday
Hey everyone, our next ACM chapter meeting is Thursday at 6pm in room 105. We'll be planning the hackathon and voting on the new logo. Pizza will be provided. See you there!

Advising appointments for Spring
Please schedule your advising appointment through Navigate before October 31. During your appointment we will review your degree audit and plan your Spring courses. Bring a list of questions.

Slides for Thursday
Hey, I finished the evaluation slide and moved the metrics into the shared deck. Can you look over the dataset section before our meeting? I think we should mention the cross-source test more clearly. Thanks!

Fire drill this Wednesday
There will be a scheduled fire drill in all residence halls on Wednesday between 7 and 9pm. When the alarm sounds, please exit using the nearest stairwell and gather in the designated area. Thank you for your cooperation.

Open enrollment for benefits begins November 1
Open enrollment for 2027 health and retirement benefits runs November 1 to November 22. Information sessions will be held in the Administration Building. Review your options in the employee portal on the official aamu.edu website or contact HR with questions.

Midterm review session
Hi all, I will hold a midterm review session on Monday at 5pm in the Engineering auditorium. We will go over sample problems on graphs and dynamic programming. The practice exam is posted on Canvas. Good luck studying.

Duo two-factor enrollment reminder
As announced earlier this semester, all students must enroll in Duo two-factor authentication by November 15. Visit the ITS page on aamu.edu or stop by the help desk for assistance. ITS staff will never ask you to share your password or verification codes.

Honors scholarship applications
The Honors College is accepting applications for the Spring merit scholarship. Applications are submitted through the scholarship portal linked from the Honors College page on aamu.edu. The deadline is December 1. Contact our office with any questions.

Homecoming week schedule
Homecoming week is almost here! Events include the step show on Wednesday, the pep rally on Friday and the parade on Saturday morning. Check the full schedule on the SGA Instagram page. Go Bulldogs!
